description: Get a compact card — title, year, genres, vote average, and (opt-in) ratings — for 1-20 movies by TMDB id in one call. Deliberately trimmed (no overview, cast, budget, certifications, production companies, etc.): use this for a single id too when you only need that headline info and not the full get_movie payload, not just for checking many at once. Call get_movie instead when you need the full details for a title (including region-specific certification). A bad/unknown id never fails the whole call — that entry comes back `{id, found:false, reason}` instead, in the same order as `ids`.

ids.description: TMDB movie ids to fetch (1-20). Get them from search_movies/discover_movies/get_similar/get_movie_recommendations/etc.

include_ratings.description: If true, enrich every card with compact IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings from OMDb (requires OMDB_API_KEY) — one extra OMDb lookup per id, so a large batch means a burst of OMDb calls; mind OMDb's own rate limit. Unlike get_movie/get_tv, defaults to false (off) here.

language.description: Override the response language (ISO-639-1, optionally with a region), e.g. 'ru-RU' or 'en-US'. Localizes titles/overviews/genre names. Defaults to the server's TMDB_LANGUAGE. A well-formed code TMDB has no translation for (e.g. 'xx') is not an error: overviews come back null, movies/shows keep their original-language title, and episodes get a generic 'Episode N' name.

name: get_movies

imdb_rating.description: IMDb user score, 0-10, as a string, e.g. '6.5'. Not TMDB's `vote_average`.

metascore.description: Metacritic critic score, 0-100 scale, as a string, e.g. '67'.

rotten_tomatoes.description: Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer — the percentage of positive critic reviews, as a string including the sign, e.g. '79%'. Not a 0-10 or 0-100 score.

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.

title: Get compact movie card(s)
